fields.description: The current value of a counter.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Lucide icon component (preferred for type-safe usage), OR a canonical kebab-case icon name string — a string is treated exactly like `name` so trait/factory authors can pass an icon by name through the `icon` prop.

name.label: Name
name.description: Icon name as string (resolved from iconMap)

strokeWidth.label: Stroke Width
strokeWidth.description: Icon stroke width - uses theme default if not specified

color.label: Color
color.description: Semantic palette token or an arbitrary Tailwind color class.

format.label: Format
format.description: Value formatting applied to string/number/Date content — `none` (the default) renders content as-is. Covers the raw-ISO-date class: a bound datetime renders human-readable via `format='date'|'time'|'datetime'`.

level.label: Level
level.description: Heading level (1-6) - alternative to variant for headings

weight.label: Weight
weight.description: Font weight override — `none` = no override, the variant's baked weight applies

className.label: Class Name
className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root element.

pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.description: Enable pulse animation for active/critical states

message.label: Message

dismissEvent.label: Dismiss Event
dismissEvent.description: Declarative dismiss event — emits UI:{dismissEvent} via eventBus when alert is dismissed

target.label: Target
target.description: Optional progress target. >0 renders a progress bar at value/target.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix prepended to the formatted value (e.g. '≈ ').

trendPolarity.label: Trend Polarity
trendPolarity.description: Controls whether `trend > 0` is 'good' (default) or 'bad'. `lower-is-better` inverts the color logic.

sparklineData.label: Sparkline Data
sparklineData.description: Optional inline sparkline data appended to the trend row. Length < 2 renders nothing.

max.label: Max
max.description: Optional denominator. >0 renders 'value / max'; 0 or omitted hides the divider.

clickEvent.label: Click Event
clickEvent.description: Event name emitted as `UI:{clickEvent}` with `{ metricLabel }` when the card is clicked.

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.description: Suffix appended to the formatted value (e.g. ' /mo', ' ms').

trend.label: Trend
trend.description: Signed delta vs previous period. >0 renders ↑ green, <0 renders ↓ red, 0 hides. Polarity reversal via `trendPolarity`.

trendFormat.label: Trend Format
trendFormat.description: When `'percent'`, renders trend with a `%` suffix (e.g. `↓ 3.3%`); default is `'absolute'`.

overrideRoles.label: Override roles
overrideRoles.description: Roles exempt from rate limiting (e.g. internal services, admin override). Empty = no exemptions.

keyStrategy.label: Rate-limit key strategy
keyStrategy.description: What identifier the per-bucket counter is keyed on: source IP, authenticated user, API key, or one global bucket.

requestsPerMinute.label: Requests per minute
requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute before throttling begins.
requestsPerMinute.synonyms: rate limit, request cap, RPS, throttle threshold

statLook.label: Stat display look
statLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for stat / KPI cards.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether rate limiting is active for the host orbital. Off by default; turn on to throttle requests.
enabled.synonyms: enable, turn on, enforce, require, activate, apply, switch on, rate limit, throttle, requests per minute, slow down, cap usage, request cap, limit traffic, prevent abuse

burstSize.label: Burst size
burstSize.description: Requests allowed to burst above the per-minute rate before steady-state throttling kicks in. Lower burst = strict/no-spikes; higher burst = forgiving/allow-spikes.
burstSize.synonyms: burst capacity, allowance, spike allowance, no-spike (low) vs allow-bursts (high)
